name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Spans and instants over time in lanes: a workflow's history as bars, stripes, dashes, ticks, diamonds and pins (the workflow, its activities, timers, child workflows, signals, markers) on a zoomable clock or since-start axis, with a toolbar, an overview strip of the whole range and running items that grow to now.
usage: Use it to show when things happened and how they overlapped, for a history, a trace or a job run: one lane per thing (with an icon and a short detail such as "activity 5"), one mark per span or instant. Pass lanes and items with times in milliseconds on one clock (epoch ms for the clock axis) and `now` for the running ones; the app decides lanes, shapes and captions. The built-in toolbar fits (Home), zooms and switches the axis between clock time and time since the start; pass filters or a follow switch as `toolbar`. The overview strip shows the whole range with the visible window, which drags to pan. With `follow`, a zoomed view slides with `now`; panning away calls `onFollowChange(false)`. Pair it with a table of the same events for exact values. It is plain DOM, windows its lanes, and zooms with + and - (Ctrl+wheel), pans with the arrows (Shift+wheel).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the timeline for assistive technology, for example "History timeline of order-1".

props.name: lanes
props.type: { id: string; label: string; detail?: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The rows, top to bottom, each with an optional icon and a muted detail after its label ("activity 5"). Thousands are fine: only the lanes in view are drawn.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; laneId: string; start: number; end: number | null; status: TimelineStatus; label: string; shape?: TimelineShape; caption?: string }[]
props.description: The spans and instants, times in ms on any one clock. `end: null` is running and grows to `now`. `shape`: bar (by status; running is a tinted outline), hatched (retrying), dashed (a timer), tick, diamond, pin. `caption` is drawn inside a bar when it fits, else after it; `label` names the item for screen readers.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time on the items' clock: running items end here and a marker shows it.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected item; its bar is ringed and aria-pressed.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a bar is pressed (click, Enter or Space).

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the since-start axis counts from; the earliest start by default.

props.name: describeItem
props.description: How a bar is described to a screen reader; "label, status, duration" by default.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when there are no lanes.

props.name: defaultAxis
props.description: What the axis reads first: clock times or the offset since the start. The toolbar switches it.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Formats the clock axis and the overview's now; local HH:MM:SS (milliseconds under a one-second step) by default.

props.name: controls
props.description: Shows the toolbar (Fit, zoom with the view's width, Clock / Since start) and the overview strip.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: More of the toolbar after the built-in controls: filter chips, a follow switch, Jump to now.

props.name: overviewLabel
props.description: The overview strip's name for the whole range, followed by its length: "Whole run · 12m 4s".

props.name: follow
props.description: Keeps `now` in a zoomed view: the window slides with the clock while items run.

props.name: onFollowChange
props.description: Called with false when the person pans away from now (keys, Shift+wheel, the overview).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own. Give it a height: the lanes scroll inside.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The focusable group; data-slot="timeline". Holds the keyboard controls.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: Fit, the zoom group with the view's width, the axis switch and the `toolbar` content; data-slot="timeline-toolbar".

slots.name: overview
slots.description: The whole range with a mark per item and the visible window; data-slot="timeline-overview", the window data-slot="timeline-window".

slots.name: axis
slots.description: The time axis with its round ticks, clock times or offsets; data-slot="timeline-axis".

slots.name: lanes
slots.description: The scrolling, windowed area of lanes; data-slot="timeline-lanes".

slots.name: lane
slots.description: One row with its icon, label, detail and track; data-slot="timeline-lane", data-selected when it holds the selected item.

slots.name: item
slots.description: One mark; data-slot="timeline-item", data-status, data-shape, data-selected and data-running name its state.

slots.name: edge
slots.description: The arrow after a mark that goes on past its end or the view; data-slot="timeline-edge".

states.name: selected
states.description: The chosen bar is ringed in color.ring.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over a bar: it dims slightly.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the timeline or a bar: Fluent's double ring (focusRing from @/lib/control).

accessibility: The timeline is a focusable role=group named by aria-label; its keys (+, -, arrows, Home) are announced by a visually hidden hint it is described by. The toolbar's buttons do the same with a pointer and are named (Zoom in, Zoom out, Fit); the view's width is announced politely.
Each mark is a native button whose label is "label, status, duration" (or describeItem), with aria-pressed when a selection is controlled.

Status is never colour alone: shapes differ (stripes, dashes, ticks, diamonds, pins), captions name the state, and the aria-label names the status. The axis and the overview are hidden from assistive technology; the marks carry the times.
Focus shows the double ring: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner (3:1 on every surface).
